name: msync
description: Cross-platform music collection sync for Spotify, Apple Music and NetEase
author: MSync contributors

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && vite build
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never
